title: Household Pricing Across a Lease's Parking Licenses
content:
Parking License pricing across a household's licenses is decided over the whole lease, not license by license.

## Clause in force — the included first permit

Only the earliest-started Surface Unreserved Permit of a lease is included without a monthly fee, and only when that product's schedule marks its first license as carrying no monthly fee. Every other Parking License of the lease pays its monthly license fee.

| License on the lease | Monthly fee |
|---|---|
| The earliest-started Surface Unreserved Permit, where the product's first license carries no monthly fee | none |
| A later-started Surface Unreserved Permit on the same lease | the product's monthly license fee |
| Any license of any other parking product | that product's monthly license fee |

*Hypothetical illustration.* A lease holds a Surface Unreserved Permit started in March and a second Surface Unreserved Permit started in June, plus a Covered Carport Space. The March permit is the earliest-started permit and carries no monthly fee; the June permit and the carport each pay their product's monthly license fee.

## Retired clauses

The following two clauses of this pricing rule are **no longer in force**. They are kept here as retired text only and are superseded by the current storage bundle discount program:

1. *Retired:* "While the lease also holds a storage rental in active status, each Covered Carport Space, Structured Garage Space, EV Charging Reserved Space and Private Detached Garage license of the lease receives a bundle discount credit of the product's storage bundle rate times that month's posted fee, rounded half up to the cent, against the monthly fee line; the discount applies to monthly fees only and never to EV charging, fines or service fees." — no longer in force.
2. *Retired:* "The bundle discount does not stack with any other parking discount and is not posted for a month in which the storage rental was not active on the fee charge day." — no longer in force.

The products' storage bundle rates themselves remain valid figures; only the handling set out in the two retired clauses has been withdrawn.

superseded_clauses: While the lease also holds a storage rental in active status, each Covered Carport Space, Structured Garage Space, EV Charging Reserved Space and Private Detached Garage license of the lease receives a bundle_discount credit of bundle_discount_with_storage_pct times that month's posted fee, rounded half up to the cent, against the monthly fee line; the discount applies to monthly fees only and never to EV charging, fines or service fees.
The bundle discount does not stack with any other parking discount and is not posted for a month in which the storage rental was not active on the fee charge day.
